enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Trace of Madness: You can almost hear faint, panicked voices when this item is close to you. Perhaps the latent power of this item's hint of madness could be brought out by some catalyst.
Piercing 6: The edges of this weapon have serrated edges, dealing an additional 6d6 piercing damage on each hit.

Heartseeker VII: On Critical Hit: 15 to 90 Piercing damage from weapons with a x2 Critical Multiplier, 15 to 120 Piercing damage from weapons with a x3 Critical Multiplier, and 15 to 150 Piercing damage from weapons with a x4 or greater Critical Multiplier.
Screeching 14: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to pulse with sound, dealing 14d6 Sonic damage on each critical hit.
Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +6d8 damage.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
